## Scope
- [ ] Update supported KiCad major/minor version range.
- [ ] Refresh `kicad-mcp-pro` upstream tool snapshot SHA and total tool count.
- [ ] Verify GitHub Actions runner OS image updates (Ubuntu, macOS, Windows).
- [ ] Synchronize `docs/architecture/compatibility-matrix.md` and `README.md`.
